title: Move the status model fixture into the pinned contract bundle when a second reader exists
body: internal/statusmodel/contract.json pins ticfac.status.v1 beside the Go code because only Go reads it today; contracts/README.md's own rule is that a fixture two languages read lives in the pinned bundle, and ticfac is forbidden from editing the vendored contracts/ (CONTRACTS.md: author it in ticks, cut a bundle version, adopt it in one commit). When i1r's phone page (TypeScript in the factory) or 2qz's TS surface starts parsing the model, the fixture should be authored upstream in ticks and adopted here with a pin bump.
